title: AC1018 TABLE direct-encoder anonymous block-name preflight
question: Does the bounded AC1018 TABLE entity-frame encoder reject inherited DRW_Insert names that it cannot serialize and that cannot participate in the required anonymous TABLE block graph?

finding.before: DRW_Table::encodeDwg validated the frame's modeled fields but accepted any inherited DRW_Insert::name. The TABLE entity frame does not encode that name. The compound writer later requires a *T-prefixed name and matches it against the emitted BLOCK_RECORD.
finding.change: The direct AC1018 encoder now requires a name of at least three bytes beginning with '*' followed by ASCII 'T' (case-insensitive) before output staging. Compound graph validation remains responsible for exact name-to-BLOCK_RECORD identity.
finding.scope: Generated AC1018 plain-text TABLE entity-frame profile only. No other versions or broader TABLE contents are admitted.

assertions: preseeded body and handle buffers are unchanged after refusal
the same object encodes after its name is corrected
existing valid AC1018 TABLE encode/readback and merge-profile controls pass
control.output: AC1018 TABLE encoder allocation failures injected=19 rollback=PASS retry=PASS; AC1018/AC1021 TABLE cell override vectors: PASS

claimBoundary: This preflight closes one direct-codec silent-omission path. It does not prove native TABLE semantics, cell rendering, additional producer profiles, R24 TABLECONTENT, or whole-source DWG conversion.
